info.name: HRMS API
info.description:
Human Resource Management System API.

1. Run **Auth > Login (Admin)** (or HR / Employee). The test script stores the JWT in `{{accessToken}}`.
2. All other requests use Bearer auth from the collection.
3. The refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie; Postman keeps it automatically so **Auth > Refresh** works.

Demo credentials are in the collection variables.

request.description:
Returns a short-lived access token (send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) and sets a
rotating refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie.

request.description: Soft delete: blocks login, revokes sessions, cancels pending leave. History is retained.
One check-in per day; a second attempt returns 409 `duplicate_check_in`.
Day-by-day calendar with status, hours and the month summary.
Everyone's status for one day (present, on leave, not checked in...).

Create or correct an attendance record. A reason is mandatory and the change is audited.
Rejected with 423 if the month's payroll is locked.
Working days, balance and estimated LOP split for a prospective request.
Deducts the balance; days beyond the available balance become Loss of Pay.
Owner can cancel pending requests (or approved ones not yet started); HR can cancel any unlocked one.

Calculates salaries for a completed month from attendance + approved leave. Re-running for a
DRAFT month recalculates it (manual adjustments are kept).
Freezes the payroll, generates payslip PDFs and emails every employee.
Simulated bank transfer: assigns a transaction reference to each payslip (no real payment).
Only payslips of locked (released) payroll runs are visible to employees.
